id: \bHe didn't know about the teleporters, huh?
en: \bHe didn't know about the teleporters, huh?
it: \bNon sapeva dei teletrasporti, eh?

id: \bPlease don't tell him. He might faint from the truth.
en: \bPlease don't tell him. He might faint from the truth.
it: \bTi prego, non dirglielo. Potrebbe svenire per la verità.

id: \rHello there. You've been invited, huh?
en: \rHello there. You've been invited, huh?
it: \rSalve. Ti hanno invitato, eh?

id: \rI heard the owner built this secret club for years. Impressive, huh?
en: \rI heard the owner built this secret club for years.  Impressive, huh?
it: \rHo sentito che il proprietario ha costruito questo club segreto in tanti anni.  Notevole, vero?

id: \rOf course, you decide if this is worth the effort. Tee hee.
en: \rOf course, you decide if this is worth the effort. Tee hee.
it: \rOvviamente sta a te decidere se ne vale la pena. Ih ih.

id: \bHuff... puff... I have heard rumours. This untold sanctuary...
en: \bHuff... puff... I have heard rumours. This untold sanctuary...
it: \bUff... puff... Ho sentito delle voci. Questo santuario sconosciuto...

id: \bThe secret hideout where the strongest trainers gather... puff... where legends are born.
en: \bThe secret hideout where the strongest trainers gather... puff... where legends are born.
it: \bIl rifugio segreto dove si riuniscono gli Allenatori più forti... puff... dove nascono le leggende.

id: \bI climbed so far and high... huff... Finally, I'm here... I need a breather...
en: \bI climbed so far and high... huff... Finally, I'm here... I need a breather...
it: \bHo scalato così tanto e così in alto... uff... Finalmente sono qui... Devo riprendere fiato...

id: \bHey, surprise surprise! \PN! We meet again! WAHAHAHA!
en: \bHey, surprise surprise! \PN! We meet again!  WAHAHAHA!
it: \bEhi, ma guarda un po'! \PN! Ci rincontriamo!  WAHAHAHA!

id: \bDon't question how I got here so fast. Don't rack your brain over it.
en: \bDon't question how I got here so fast. Don't rack your brain over it.
it: \bNon chiederti come ho fatto ad arrivare qui così in fretta. Non scervellarti.

id: \bAnyway, WELCOME TO THE GRANDEUR CLUB! WAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
en: \bAnyway, WELCOME TO THE GRANDEUR CLUB!  WAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
it: \bComunque, BENVENUTO AL GRANDEUR CLUB!  WAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!

id: \bI have been hearing lots of feedback from everyone, from finishing all of the post game events, waiting for Galar, yadda yadda.
en: \bI have been hearing lots of feedback from everyone, from finishing all of the post game events, waiting for Galar, yadda yadda.
it: \bHo ricevuto un sacco di commenti da tutti: chi ha finito tutti gli eventi del post-game, chi aspetta Galar, bla bla bla.

id: \bPersonally, I was looking for a post-game challenge too. So I built this, with the help of my co-founder, Luc!
en: \bPersonally, I was looking for a post-game challenge too. So I built this, with the help of my co-founder, Luc!
it: \bPersonalmente, anch'io cercavo una sfida per il post-game. Così ho costruito questo posto, con l'aiuto del mio cofondatore, Luc!

id: \bBy the looks of it, you ain't no simpleton either! You're like me, somebody looking for a real challenge, am I right?
en: \bBy the looks of it, you ain't no simpleton either! You're like me, somebody looking for a real challenge, am I right?
it: \bA quanto pare, non sei uno sprovveduto nemmeno tu! Sei come me, uno che cerca una vera sfida, ho ragione?

id: \bI guess I am, I can practically smell the excitement on you. Well then, without further ado, take this.
en: \bI guess I am, I can practically smell the excitement on you. Well then, without further ado, take this.
it: \bDirei di sì, sento quasi l'odore dell'eccitazione che hai addosso. Bene allora, senza ulteriori indugi, prendi questo.

id: \bLuc and I will be looking forward to your performance here. MUAHAHAHA!
en: \bLuc and I will be looking forward to your performance here. MUAHAHAHA!
it: \bIo e Luc non vediamo l'ora di vedere come te la caverai qui. MUAHAHAHA!

id: \bTaking a breather after a loss. It feels sad yet refreshing at the same time.
en: \bTaking a breather after a loss. It feels sad yet refreshing at the same time.
it: \bRiprendo fiato dopo una sconfitta. È triste e rinfrescante allo stesso tempo.

id: \bEvery time I go in, it's always a brand-new experience, waiting for me to break through!
en: \bEvery time I go in, it's always a brand-new experience, waiting for me to break through!
it: \bOgni volta che entro è un'esperienza sempre nuova, che aspetta solo che io la superi!

id: \bGood luck!
en: \bGood luck!
it: \bBuona fortuna!

id: \bGood view, isn't it? The sunshine's embrace makes you warm. The cool breeze refreshes your senses. What a great place for good ol' lad to tell his legacy.
en: \bGood view, isn't it? The sunshine's embrace makes you warm. The cool breeze refreshes your senses. What a great place for good ol' lad to tell his legacy.
it: \bBella vista, vero? L'abbraccio del sole ti scalda. La brezza fresca ti risveglia i sensi. Che posto magnifico per un vecchio come me per raccontare la sua eredità.

id: \bA minor mishap made me bedridden and out of action from work. The pandemic also kept me away from my loved one. I got bored till I found this world. 2 months of running around, gathering allies and defeating foes to the finish line.
en: \bA minor mishap made me bedridden and out of action from work. The pandemic also kept me away from my loved one. I got bored till I found this world. 2 months of running around, gathering allies and defeating foes to the finish line.
it: \bUn piccolo incidente mi ha costretto a letto e lontano dal lavoro. La pandemia mi ha anche tenuto lontano dalla persona che amo. Mi annoiavo, finché non ho trovato questo mondo. 2 mesi passati a correre in giro, radunare alleati e sconfiggere nemici fino al traguardo.

id: \bI craved for more and this world deserved more, but the Driftveil Battle House wasn't a kicker for me. I NEEDED MORE. I seeked. I learned. Finally, I discovered this beautiful land. And with my friends, we're on a mission.
en: \bI craved for more and this world deserved more, but the Driftveil Battle House wasn't a kicker for me. I NEEDED MORE. I seeked. I learned. Finally, I discovered this beautiful land. And with my friends, we're on a mission.
it: \bVolevo di più e questo mondo meritava di più, ma la Casa Lotta di Libecciopoli non mi bastava. AVEVO BISOGNO DI PIÙ. Ho cercato. Ho imparato. Alla fine ho scoperto questa terra meravigliosa. E con i miei amici, siamo partiti per una missione.

id: \bTop trainers across the multiverse gathered in the Grandeur Lounge to pit against each other. Challenges expanded and became more fleshed out.
en: \bTop trainers across the multiverse gathered in the Grandeur Lounge to pit against each other. Challenges expanded and became more fleshed out.
it: \bI migliori Allenatori di tutto il multiverso si sono radunati nel Grandeur Lounge per sfidarsi tra loro. Le sfide si sono ampliate e sono diventate più ricche.

id: \bBut no, I am still not satisfied. I need to break the limit. I need to give them what they want. I need the BIG BAD.
en: \bBut no, I am still not satisfied. I need to break the limit. I need to give them what they want. I need the BIG BAD.
it: \bMa no, non ero ancora soddisfatto. Dovevo superare il limite. Dovevo dare loro ciò che volevano. Mi serviva il BOSS FINALE.

id: \bSo we experimented on all possible limits. We broke the constraints. And I had bigger, loftier dreams. Paldea! We fed our desires... till now.
en: \bSo we experimented on all possible limits. We broke the constraints. And I had bigger, loftier dreams. Paldea! We fed our desires... till now.
it: \bCosì abbiamo sperimentato ogni limite possibile. Abbiamo infranto le regole. E io avevo sogni più grandi, più ambiziosi. Paldea! Abbiamo inseguito i nostri desideri... fino a oggi.

id: \bEducation. Career. Marriage. Kids. Commitment arises. That's when I knew, our time was limited. Hahahaha.
en: \bEducation. Career. Marriage. Kids. Commitment arises. That's when I knew, our time was limited.  Hahahaha.
it: \bStudio. Carriera. Matrimonio. Figli. Arrivano gli impegni. È stato allora che ho capito che il nostro tempo era limitato.  Hahahaha.

id: \bThe world that Reinhart formed. The systems that Luc-ker expanded on. The peak that I envisioned. 5 years. It finally ends here. This is probably the final legacy.
en: \bThe world that Reinhart formed. The systems that Luc-ker expanded on. The peak that I envisioned. 5 years. It finally ends here. This is probably the final legacy.
it: \bIl mondo che Reinhart ha creato. I sistemi che Luc-ker ha ampliato. La vetta che io ho immaginato. 5 anni. Finalmente finisce qui. Questa è probabilmente l'eredità finale.

id: \bMy legacy could've been just been between a few chosen ones. But Reinhart trusted and passed the baton to us to continue this journey in the ways we can, and I am appreciative of that.
en: \bMy legacy could've been just been between a few chosen ones. But Reinhart trusted and passed the baton to us to continue this journey in the ways we can, and I am appreciative of that.
it: \bLa mia eredità poteva restare tra pochi eletti. Ma Reinhart si è fidato e ci ha passato il testimone per continuare questo viaggio come possiamo, e gliene sono grato.

id: \bSo yeah. That's it. Thanks for listening to my yapping. Heh.
en: \bSo yeah. That's it. Thanks for listening to my yapping. Heh.
it: \bQuindi sì. È tutto. Grazie per aver ascoltato le mie chiacchiere. Eh.

id: \bWere you expecting more? Have you met Luc and Foul through this system?
en: \bWere you expecting more? Have you met Luc and Foul through this system?
it: \bTi aspettavi di più? Hai incontrato Luc e Foul attraverso questo sistema?

id: \bI guess I could spare some time for you. I did promise the BIG BAD to you.
en: \bI guess I could spare some time for you. I did promise the BIG BAD to you.
it: \bImmagino di poterti dedicare un po' di tempo. Ti avevo promesso il BOSS FINALE, dopotutto.

id: \bThis shouldn't be difficult for you. Alright?
en: \bThis shouldn't be difficult for you. Alright?
it: \bNon dovrebbe essere difficile per te. Va bene?

id: \bYou did it. You defeated the BIG BAD. I'm truly proud of you. *sigh*
en: \bYou did it. You defeated the BIG BAD. I'm truly proud of you. *sigh*
it: \bCe l'hai fatta. Hai sconfitto il BOSS FINALE. Sono davvero fiero di te. *sigh*

id: \bThis is really finally all over for me. Let me bring you back. And I will go back to my spot.
en: \bThis is really finally all over for me. Let me bring you back. And I will go back to my spot.
it: \bOra per me è davvero tutto finito. Lascia che ti riporti indietro. E io tornerò al mio posto.

id: \bAnd goodbye.
en: \bAnd goodbye.
it: \bE addio.

id: The cool breeze refreshes your Pokémon...
en: The cool breeze refreshes your Pokémon...
it: La brezza fresca rinvigorisce i tuoi Pokémon...
